author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Local News The wreck’s proximity to a turbine at Block Island Wind Farm has raised long-unanswered questions about the cause of the ship’s demise.

title: Medfield police chief on paid leave amid investigation into alleged policy violations
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Local News Town officials said they have hired an outside investigator to look into the allegations against the police chief.

By Darin Zullo September 27, 2026 | 9:57 AM 2 minutes to read Medfield Police Chief Michelle Guerette was placed on paid administrative leave Wednesday amid allegations that she violated department policies, town officials said.
The town of Medfield did not specify what policies Guerette allegedly violated, but it has hired an outside investigator to look into the allegations, officials said in a press release.
